Animated Static (Motion-Graphic Packshot.definition: A 5-15s ad that is basically a static image ad brought to life: one product packshot (or offer card) on a designed background, a bold headline, then benefit callouts, a stat, a price/offer badge or a countdown animate in one by one, ending on the packshot + CTA. No people talking, no footage story.
Animated Static (Motion-Graphic Packshot.why: Cheapest video asset to make and test: it gets static-ad clarity (product + promise + offer in one glance) into Reels/Stories placements, and the motion buys the extra second of attention a flat static loses.
how: Take a clean packshot (or render) of the product on a brand-colour or moody background and write one punchy headline.
Animate in 3-4 elements in sequence: benefit tags/leader-line callouts, one stat ('91% saw results'), then the offer badge or a ticking timer.
Hold on the full card for 2-3s with the CTA; export 9:16 and 4:5, swap only headline/offer for variants.
Animated Static (Motion-Graphic Packshot.closest_existing: Text-Wall Story (Read-Along Still): both are 'one still', but that is a long first-person story to read; this is a product packshot with short callouts/offer animating in.

Flipbook Slideshow (Fixed Frame, Cards F.definition: A 6-15s motion graphic where the frame stays locked (brand header, sale line or 'live now' label) while the image in the middle flips every ~0.5-1.5s through many cards: each product/SKU/colourway as a cutout or model+flat-lay card, or the brand's own past sale creatives. It ends on the last card or a shop-now card.
Flipbook Slideshow (Fixed Frame, Cards F.why: Shows the whole range or offer history in one scroll-stopping rhythm; the fixed headline carries the message (new drop, sale, 'we won't do this again') while the flipping cards keep eyes on it. Ideal for multi-SKU stores and sales.
how: Lock a template: brand name + one line ('Live now', 'Up to 40% off', 'We won't do this again') and a clean white or brand-colour background.
Drop in 6-12 product cutouts / colourways (or screenshots of your past sale statics), one per card, each with its name or price.
Flip a card every 0.5-1.5s to a beat, add a ticker/countdown if it's a sale, end on a shop-now card; export 9:16.
Flipbook Slideshow (Fixed Frame, Cards F.closest_existing: Try-On Haul / Collection Lookbook show range with live footage of a person; this is a pure graphic template where only the card in a fixed frame changes.

Sale Flipbook Countdown.definition: Fixed urgency header ('WE WON'T DO THIS AGAIN / up to 50% off now') + FINAL HOURS ticker while the frame rapid-flips through the brand's past sale creatives; 6s loop.
Sale Flipbook Countdown.why: Reuses old sale statics to signal 'this is the best deal we've ever run' with zero new production.
how: Place them in a fixed frame under one urgency headline and a scrolling 'final hours' ticker.
